title: Announcing Zep's New Web Admin UI! 🔥🎉
summary: View, edit, and delete Users, Sessions, and Collections. See complete message histories, data enrichments, and more.
body_markdown:
Zep v0.12.0, released today, now includes a web admin user interface.


Manage Users and their Sessions:


User View


View complete Chat Histories and enrichment, such as summaries and named entities:


Chat History with Summary and Enrichments


Manage document collections, indexes, and view embedding status:


Document Collection


## Other improvements and fixes in this release


- Feat: Specify the host address you'd like Zep to bind to.
- Fix:` UpdatedAt` fields are now updated correctly
- Fix: Optional User fields remain null on creation/edit of a user.


A full changelog is[available in the release notes](https://github.com/getzep/zep/releases/tag/v0.12.0) .
